correctness.rationale: The repaired result uses the exact common action (b,c)↦(ec,gc) over R=K[z]/(z^s) on A_{2s} and tA_{2s+1}, with constants providing a trivial complement in the latter. The condition on the coefficient of ∂t is vacuous at length 2s and exactly vanishing of its constant term at length 2s+1; this proves surjectivity, also at s=1. Faithfulness and the single intertwiner give restricted compatibility and all claimed operator consequences. The original rank formula is also correct: D²=0 iff eg=g²=0; the annihilator of (e,g) has codimension s−min(v(e),v(g)). With h=floor(s/2), among ranks ≤r the g=0 contribution is q^r, and nonzero g with v(g)=s−m, 1≤m≤min(h,r), contributes (q−1)q^{m−1+min(r,s−m)}. Differencing gives the stated low and high coefficients and the s=1 total. Fresh basis-matrix corroboration checked both lengths and their intertwiner for F₂ (s≤4) and F₄ (s≤3), saved as record3_matrix_check.py and record3_matrix_check.txt with the review work. These are bounded tests, not the all-field proof. The frozen verifier was inspected but not executed.

value.rationale: Passing from equal ranks or isomorphic Lie brackets to an explicit stable equivalence on natural modules answers a different, natural representation question. It transports simultaneous operator information and gives the exact effect on Jordan blocks and ranks of powers for arbitrary derivations and all truncation lengths in characteristic two. This is an independently usable structural result; the covered census contributes no novelty or value credit here.
